messages:
sam (partnerships): Quick heads-up — Datadog partner team asked to demo an inline telemetry widget embedded in our marketplace tile next Wed (APAC-friendly time). Need eng + obs + SI alignment for tech handoff and privacy checks. Who can take point?
keiko (si lead): I can lead SI handoff. Need integration spec, sample collector, and an agentless fallback for airgapped customers.
maria (obs PM): I will own the dashboard UX and sample queries. Please share OTLP exporter config, sample spans, and retention requirements.
jake (eng): I can stub the SDK/embed. Two quick Qs: 1) embed auth model? 2) CORS + CSP implications for the marketplace iframe.
datadog-bot: Reminder: Partner portal requires MarketplaceTileIntegration form: https://partners.datadog.example/submit — include planned endpoints and ingest region.
sam (partnerships): Auth options discussed: signed JWT from our control plane, or short-lived token minted by partner service. Preference: JWT with KMS-signed claims for trace provenance. @jake can our control plane sign?
jake (eng): Yes we can issue JWTs via our KMS, but need key rotation and verification docs. I can prototype a middleware that validates the token and injects a temporary session header. ETA ~48h.
keiko (si lead): For SI installs: airgap customers will need a local collector image + a config example that forwards to a regional Datadog endpoint. Also need docs on TLS pinning for gov customers.
maria (obs PM): Dashboard plan: three tabs — traces, errors, perf heatmap. Will import a prebuilt dashboard if Datadog provides export JSON. Sample span for the demo (small):
```json
{"trace_id":"abcd1234","span":"inference.request","service":"redwood-inference","latency_ms":12,"attrs":{"model":"redwood-13b","region":"apac-1"}}
```
jake (eng): Got the span example. For ingest, suggest sampling at 1% baseline for demo to keep token counts low. Also need OTLP endpoint URL and expected headers.
sam (partnerships): Ops question — data residency: APAC tile must not route traces out of region. Datadog partner rep claimed regional ingestion is available. Can we confirm region-limited keys?
datadog-bot: Datadog APAC endpoints available: https://apac.datadoghq.com. Regional ingestion keys & limited routing supported via partner account. Contact rep: partners-asia@datadog.example.
maria (obs PM): Also need the dashboard export (JSON) and recommended widgets. @datadog-bot any sample export for LLM inference traces?
datadog-bot: Sample dashboard export link: https://dd.example/sample-llm-inference-dashboard.json — contains traces, latency heatmap, error rate monitor.
jake (eng): I'll add a small middleware + CORS headers to the marketplace tile and prototype JWT verification. Leaving a TODO: rotate key every 30 days, add JWK endpoint.
keiko (si lead): SI checklist items: containerized collector + env var examples + fallback to file-based buffer for disconnected customers. I'll draft.
sam (partnerships): Next steps and owners: Jake — prototype JWT middleware & CORS (48h). Maria — import dashboard draft from Datadog export (48h). Keiko — SI collector + airgap doc (72h). Sam — complete partner portal submission and announce demo window. Weekly sync: Thu 09:30 PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:
